about: The navigation shell, whole: level-1 sections and their level-2 sub-views. render.py builds both
tab strips, the pre-paint CSS and the page's embedded copy of this file from it; boot.js reads that
copy before the first paint; shell.js routes (#/{section}/{subview}), keys and remembers from it.
Adding a sub-view is one entry here. A sub-view with no 'tab' renders its 'empty' state in the
shell's own pane, so a new one is never a blank screen.
Section: id, label, route, account ('none' | 'uses': renders without a wallet, resets to its first
sub-view when the wallet changes | 'required': a single connect screen while disconnected),
accent, optional hint (tooltip) and badge, and optional entry: 'first' opens the section on its first
view every time - from its level-1 tab and on a reload - instead of the view last open.
Sub-view: id, label, route, optional group (sub-views sharing a group sit together under its
label), and either what it shows - tab (the window's pane, html[data-tab]), panel (its element
id), ui/screen for the dashboard's two views - or an empty state {title, text, action?}.
